$comment: Familiar species (design doc S4). The kith is a collection of individuals: at most ONE familiar of each species ever walks with the warden (each has unique plate art), and each species carries a single fixed trait. A node specialist now works a PAIR of related nodes (e.g. copper + tin), so one familiar answers either node's gift pile and boosts both wherever it is posted (wandering is watch-only as of 2026-08-09 — a wanderer gathers nothing, so nodeYieldBonus carries nothing at the wander post). Trait kinds the sim interprets: nodeYieldBonus (at a node whose resource is in trait.resources), digSpeedBonus (at a watch site), choiceBonus (points at its node, any resource), bubbleRewardBonus (windfall bubbles pay more while its familiar walks - the raven fetches them home), wardenYieldBonus (the warden's own hands work faster while its familiar walks - the fell pony of The Drover's Halter carries for them, S11). Node specialists arrive by gift pile at either of their nodes (one pile per verse sung); the raven arrives through the recruit rungs and bonds. The roster is sized to the gatherable nodes: twelve pair-specialists cover every priced find on the map, all eight zones built — the peaks add no species because the ermine and the pika already reach into them (glacier ice, sky-blossoms), which is the roster principle holding rather than a gap: a thirteenth familiar would have no find of its own to specialise. Each species' animal matches the powerup it gives. Names each start with a distinct letter. inscriptions = the plate's margin lines (design S7, the channel about individuals): one is earned per signature milestone passed (economy.familiarXp.signatureMilestones), in order, in the warden's hand — draft wording, re-voice with the narrative pass. Values are first guesses.

species.name: Meadow vole

trait.name: Meadow-forager
trait.description: +40% yield at berry and wildflower nodes

inscriptions: Knows my step now. Doesn't look up.
Found the last ripe cane in the rain, and left me half.
Third season she has found me. I have stopped calling it luck.

species.name: Red squirrel

trait.name: Mast-hoarder
trait.description: +40% yield at nut and mushroom nodes

inscriptions: Buries more than he digs up. The wood is in his debt.
Showed me a cache I never taught him. I think it was a gift.
Old now, and still burying. No winter has caught him short.

species.name: Sedge linnet

trait.name: Nest-weaver
trait.description: +40% yield at fibre and reed nodes

inscriptions: Pulls the year's best grasses first, and sings over the work.
Wove a strand of my rope into her nest. I take that as a wage.
The reeds bend before she lands now. They know her.

species.name: Bramble hare

trait.name: Hedge-browser
trait.description: +40% yield at herb and rare-herb nodes

inscriptions: Tastes the hedge for what's ripe. Leaves my mistakes on the stem.
Steered me round the thorn patch by sitting still in front of it.
The hedge opens for her. I have seen it, and I won't argue.

species.name: Warren weasel

trait.name: Ore-tunneler
trait.description: +40% yield at copper scree and tin seam nodes

inscriptions: Follows the seam like a burrow. Comes up dusted green.
Taps the stone twice where it's worth my while. Twice, always.
The hill lets him through. I dig where he tells me now.

species.name: Furrow hedgehog

trait.name: Earth-rooter
trait.description: +40% yield at clay and iron gravel nodes

inscriptions: Roots the wet ground, and huffs when it's good.
Sleeps in the clay pit as if the ground had been warmed for him.
The earth gives him what it hides from my spade.

species.name: Tawny owl

trait.name: Grove-and-river hunter
trait.description: +40% yield at timber and fishing nodes

inscriptions: Works the wood's edge and the shallows, and judges my knots.
Left a trout at my feet at dusk. No comment offered.
The river and the wood have settled which one owns her. Neither.

species.name: Osier otter

trait.name: Fen-swimmer
trait.description: +40% yield at peat and glow-moss nodes

inscriptions: Works the wet margins as if the water owed him.
Brought the moss up glowing and dry. I no longer ask how.
The fen holds its breath around him. He has never once noticed.

species.name: Horseshoe bat

trait.name: Dark-delver
trait.description: +40% yield at deep ore and crystal nodes

inscriptions: Hangs over the lamp while I work. I have decided this is company.
Found the seam by singing at it. The stone sang back.
The dark is her country and she its keeper. Nothing below moves unannounced.

species.name: Ermine

trait.name: Winter-walker
trait.description: +40% yield at ashglass and glacier ice nodes

inscriptions: White as the glass he digs. The ash does not stick to him.
Circled the pit all night. No other track comes near it.
He wears the old winter like it was fitted. Perhaps it was.

species.name: Kea

trait.name: Flock-rider
trait.description: +40% yield at egg and wool nodes

inscriptions: Undid the strap I tied twice, and left the buckle where I'd find it. A fee, I think.
Rides the ewes down the slope for the joy of it. The flock has voted to allow this.
The wind is his and he lends it. Nothing on this mountain is closed to him now.

species.name: Pika

trait.name: Hay-piler
trait.description: +40% yield at lichen and sky-blossom nodes

inscriptions: Cuts her hay in the sun hours and stacks it under the one dry stone. I have started copying her.
Whistles the hawk's arrival before the hawk. The whole slope moves on her word.
Her winter is stacked and dried by midsummer. The cold arrives and finds it owes her.

species.name: Pack raven

trait.name: Deep pockets
trait.description: Windfall bubbles pay +25% more while she walks, because she fetches them home

inscriptions: Carries more than looks possible, and counts every piece.
Took the long way round the storm and set down nothing.
I have stopped checking the loads. Her idea, somehow.

species.name: Fell pony

trait.name: Half-broke
trait.description: Carries what the warden picks, so their hands never leave the work. The warden's own gathering +50%

inscriptions: Came down off the fell on her own account and has stayed on it.
Will take the panniers. Will not take the halter twice.
Ten winters of her own weather in her. I lead her nowhere; we go the same way.
